title: My morning
subtitle: Early birds and late birds — the present simple
canDo: I can talk about my morning routine.
I can use the present simple with I, you, we and they.
I can understand a short text about daily life.
teacherNotes: Warm-up: Kendi sabahınızı 3–4 cümleyle anlatın ("I get up at 7. I drink tea…"), sonra öğrencilere sorun.
Türk öğrenciler özneyi düşürebilir ("Get up at eight"); İngilizcede özne her zaman söylenir.
Hem Türk hem Arap öğrencilerde "I am get up" / "I am work" hatası sık görülür: be + fiil birlikte kullanılmaz.
Bu derste sadece I / you / we / they var; he / she -s ekini 3.3'te öğretiyoruz. Okuma metninde tanıma amaçlı geçebilir.

sections.title: Warm-up
prompts: What time do you get up?
What do you have for breakfast?
Are you an early bird or a late bird?

items.example: I take a shower in the morning.
I get dressed and have breakfast.
I brush my teeth after breakfast.
I go to work at seven.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Early bird
sections.scene: Monday, 8:45 a.m. Elif and Omar at the school door.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Good morning, Omar! You look tired.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Good morning. I work at the hospital at night on Mondays.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: At night? And you come to class in the morning?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yes. I finish work at seven, I have breakfast, and I come here.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Wow. I get up at eight, and I'm always tired!

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Ha! What do you have for breakfast?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: A Turkish breakfast: bread, cheese, olives, tomatoes and tea.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's a real breakfast! I drink coffee and eat a banana.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Only a banana? Come on, Omar!

support.tr: Tekrar oku. Doğru mu, yanlış mı?
support.ar: اقرأ مرة أخرى. صح أم خطأ؟

items.statement: Omar works at night on Mondays.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Our mornings
sections.intro: Elif writes about mornings in her class.
paragraphs: My classmates and I have very different mornings.
I take a shower, get dressed and have a big Turkish breakfast.
Lucas and his roommates get up late.
They drink coffee, eat a cookie and run to school!
We start class at nine and finish at twelve.
After class, we go to Sam's café.
We drink tea and do our homework.

sections.title: Grammar: present simple (I, you, we, they)
rules: Use the present simple for things you do every day (routines).
I / you / we / they + verb: I **work**, they **walk**
Time words: every day, in the morning, at 7:00
examples: You drink a lot of coffee!

support.tr: Present simple (geniş zaman) her gün ya da genellikle yaptığımız işler içindir: I get up at eight = Saat sekizde kalkarım. I, you, we, they ile fiil yalın kalır, ek almaz. Türkçeden farklı olarak özne (I, we …) mutlaka söylenir: "Get up at eight" değil, "I get up at eight".
support.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط (present simple) للعادات اليومية: I get up at eight = أنهض في الثامنة. مع I و you و we و they يبقى الفعل كما هو. وعلى عكس العربية لا بدّ من ذكر الفاعل: نقول I get up ولا نقول get up وحدها، لأن الفعل الإنجليزي لا يحمل ضمير الفاعل.

tr.note: Türkçede özneyi düşürebiliriz (kalkarım), İngilizcede düşüremeyiz. Fiilden önce am / are de koyma.
wrong: Get up at eight every day.
I am get up at eight.
right: I get up at eight every day.

ar.note: لا تضع am / is / are قبل الفعل في المضارع البسيط.
wrong: I am work in a hospital.

items.audio: I get up at nine, and I run to school!
I start work at eight thirty.
I open the café at seven every day.

sections.title: Write

model.heading: Omar's morning
text: I take a shower and get dressed.
I drink a coffee and eat a banana.
I go to work at six.

checklist: Every sentence has I at the start.
I don't write am / are before the verb.
